summary: APS mismatch event delayed by 35ms under high CPU load
description: Under sustained 95% CPU load the DiagnosticEvent_APS_Mismatch is logged 35ms after fault injection instead of the required 20ms. Reproduced consistently on HW Rev B.

summary: Safe state torque reduction reaches 0 Nm in 28ms (spec: 20ms)
description: Oscilloscope measurement shows torque output takes 28ms to reach 0 Nm from the moment APS mismatch is latched. 8ms overshoot observed. Linked to JIRA-001 CPU load issue.

summary: CAN bus latency spikes to 12ms during gateway node reset
description: During ECU gateway node reset cycle CAN message latency temporarily spikes to 12ms (2x the 5ms limit). Duration ~200ms per reset. Affects REQ-002.

summary: NVM write failure on brake pressure error log under low-voltage condition
description: At supply voltage 9.5V (brownout scenario) NVM write fails silently for CAN error log entries. No error returned to caller. Data loss risk.

summary: Firmware update via OBD-II causes 150ms CAN bus blackout
description: During OBD-II firmware flash sequence the CAN bus is silent for 150ms. Affects REQ-003 (shall not interrupt operation) and secondary systems polling CAN.

summary: Steering sensor plausibility check uses 3ms cycle instead of 5ms spec
description: Implementation polls both steering sensors every 3ms introducing unnecessary CPU load. No safety impact but deviates from TSR-003 spec cycle time.

summary: System response time 62ms on first boot cycle
description: On cold start the first driver input event receives a 62ms response (spec: 50ms). Subsequent events are within spec. Caused by lazy initialisation of input handler.
